home.question: Is the shop header shown at the top, with the navigation links and the cart icon readable?
Is all text readable, with no text overlapping other text and nothing covering content it should not?
Does the page fit the width of the screen, with nothing cut off at the left or right edge?
Are all values real text, with no raw template placeholders or code (such as {{price}} or undefined) shown?
Does the hero banner show a heading and a Shop now button?

category.question: Is the shop header shown at the top, with the navigation links and the cart icon readable?
Is all text readable, with no text overlapping other text and nothing covering content it should not?
Does the page fit the width of the screen, with nothing cut off at the left or right edge?
Are all values real text, with no raw template placeholders or code (such as {{price}} or undefined) shown?
Are products shown as cards, each with a picture, a name and a price?
Have all the product pictures loaded (no broken-image icons or empty picture boxes)?

product.question: Is the shop header shown at the top, with the navigation links and the cart icon readable?
Is all text readable, with no text overlapping other text and nothing covering content it should not?
Does the page fit the width of the screen, with nothing cut off at the left or right edge?
Are all values real text, with no raw template placeholders or code (such as {{price}} or undefined) shown?
Are the product picture, the product name and its price all shown?
Is the price shown in US dollars (US$ or $)?
Is there a quantity selector and a visible Add to cart button?

cart.question: Is the shop header shown at the top, with the navigation links and the cart icon readable?
Is all text readable, with no text overlapping other text and nothing covering content it should not?
Does the page fit the width of the screen, with nothing cut off at the left or right edge?
Are all values real text, with no raw template placeholders or code (such as {{price}} or undefined) shown?
Does each cart line show the product name, unit price, quantity and subtotal?
For every cart line, is the subtotal equal to the unit price times the quantity?
Is a cart total shown, and is it equal to the sum of the line subtotals?
Is there a visible button or link to proceed to checkout?

checkout.question: Is the shop header shown at the top, with the navigation links and the cart icon readable?
Is all text readable, with no text overlapping other text and nothing covering content it should not?
Does the page fit the width of the screen, with nothing cut off at the left or right edge?
Are all values real text, with no raw template placeholders or code (such as {{price}} or undefined) shown?
Is a billing details form shown, with labelled fields?
Does the order summary list the products and show a total?
Is the Place your order button visible and not covered by anything?
